 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Wisconsin Badgers are back in action on Friday evening, taking on the Delaware Blue Hens after their 75-68 win over Denver in the season opener. Tip-off is set for 6:30 p.m. at the Kohl Center on Big Ten Plus.
 Wisconsin is coming off a rough opener where they never trailed, but also failed to put the game away for good. They shot the ball poorly, had sloppy moments with turnovers, saw some defensive struggles, and didn't have a great overall day.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement So, despite being 25.5-point favorites, the Badgers won by just seven. Newcomers Eian Elmer and Owen Foxwell had solid starts to their Wisconsin careers, but Nolan Winter struggled, shooting 3 of 10 from the field, while missing all of his threes and free throws.
 Wisconsin tinkered with its rotation a bit in the preseason, and went with Foxwell, Braeden Carrington, Elmer, Winter, and Victory Onuetu as their starters in the opener. It'll be the same group on Friday.
 The bigger question is the team's depth, as Wisconsin has a ton of bodies looking to crack the rotation. So, we'll have to continue seeing who's earning minutes and how they're being divided.
 Heading into Friday, the Badgers are 24.5-point favorites. We'll see if they can perform to expectations here in Game 2.
